newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds slightly up, look to U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds slightly up, look to U.S. data.

text.p: Argentine bonds were flat to higher late morning Monday amid thin activity as traders awaited key U.S. economic indicators later in the week to provide some direction.
"It is very quiet," said a trader at a local bank. She said, however, that there was some buyer interest from foreign banks in the morning.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 rose 1/8 to 92-3/8, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was flat at 115.03.
Another trader said the market was slightly unnerved in the morning after a decline in the dollar against the yen.
The trader added that the market was set to take its cue from the United States this week with retail sales figures and key inflation data due for release.
